Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning — excited to continue supporting ZenOptic’s inference rollout. As discussed, attached is a proposal to add a dedicated reserved pool for your production traffic alongside your upcoming annual renewal. High-level summary: 

- Expansion: +8x A100 equivalent GPUs (shared reserved pool)
- Throughput: baseline 350k tokens/min sustained, with burst to 500k tokens/min (SLA tiers available)
- Terming: propose co-terming the new capacity to your existing contract renewal date (2027-01-31) to simplify billing and procurement (see two pricing options below)

Pricing options (USD, monthly invoiced):
1) Standard commit (12 months until co-term): $35,000 / month for the +8 GPUs (no additional discount)
2) Upsell commit (12 months + 12 month extension to align to co-term): $30,000 / month + one-time API credits $15k applied (effective 14% ARR discount)

We can either:
- Issue a PO amendment that extends your current contract term and adds the reserved pool (co-term approach), OR
- Add the expansion as a stand-alone reserved pool with its own billing cadence and then issue a co-terming PO at renewal.

Attached draft: PO_Amendment_ZenOptic_v2.pdf (redlines included) and a capacity schedule spreadsheet. If procurement prefers a single invoice schedule, we can push the amendment so invoices align with your Jan 31 renewal date.

Next steps I recommend:
- Procurement: confirm preferred invoicing cadence (immediate monthly vs. co-term consolidation)
- Legal: review PO amendment redlines (I’ve highlighted the SLO and termination paragraphs)
- Engineering: confirm target go-live window (we're tentatively holding capacity starting 2026-05-15)

Looping in Dylan for any technical notes on placement and Marcus for pricing flexibility.
